snippet.title: The Remake of the End of the Greatest RPG of All Time  | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
What we've been working on 

"The Remake of the End of the Greatest RPG of All Time" (TRotEotGRPGoAT for short) is a deduction puzzle game set in the last hour of a lost (nonexistent) JRPG’s "remake,” where players must use the director’s commentary, the original manual, and clips of unreleased amateur documentary, to uncover the question at the core of it all: What is the Greatest RPG of All Time?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2809660/The_Remake_of_the_End_of_the_Greatest_RPG_of_All_Time/
